summary: Implemented the unknown-total speed display in rich/progress.py: track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to TaskProgressColumn; TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False), a class-level render_speed, and a speed branch in render(); Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables and declares task_total as Optional[float]. Added a CHANGELOG line, test_task_progress_column_speed, and removed the two ValueError assertions in tests/test_progress.py. Nothing was run (no tests, black, or mypy), so those checks are unverified. Progress.get_default_columns still builds TaskProgressColumn() with show_speed off, since it is outside the spec's scope.
